listing.name: Project Sylpheed: Arc of Deception — sylpheed (stuken)
listing.summary: A game-specific native project exists. Full-game compatibility is unknown. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Project Sylpheed: Arc of Deception Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 535107D4 plus TU0.0.1.2 default.xexp; this guide does not include the MD5 values for the original executable and title-update file. Check the project’s exact original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build SDK, dump own TU-patched Sylpheed XEX, generate code/shaders and compile Windows runtime.

warnings: A game-specific native project exists. Full-game compatibility is unknown.
